title: 真实ext_authz故障拒绝：鉴权500不放行业务，保留健康检查和正常授权路径

body:
## 操作任务
实现configure(base)返回深拷贝，修复其中ext_authz的failure_mode_allow：鉴权HTTP 5xx/通信失败必须拒绝业务并按ServiceUnavailable返回503；鉴权显式403保持403；鉴权允许时仍可访问原service。不得禁用过滤器、改cluster或删除原/health精确路由的鉴权豁免，健康检查依然直接200/ready且不调用鉴权服务。不能信任客户端伪造的x-envoy-auth-failure-mode-allowed头。验收实际运行Envoy、独立鉴权HTTP服务及业务HTTP服务，核对被拒绝的请求没有到达业务上游。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Envoy1.36.13 HTTP ext_authz错误、明确拒绝与允许三态；健康豁免是题定原有策略。未部署生产认证系统、未验证gRPC鉴权、正文截断或route cache变更。

import os,sys,pathlib,copy,json,time,base64
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from envoy_native import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm,routes,student
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with Upstream() as service,Upstream(status=500) as auth:
 base=bootstrap(service.port);cluster=copy.deepcopy(base['static_resources']['clusters'][0]);cluster['name']='authz';cluster['load_assignment']['cluster_name']='authz';cluster['load_assignment']['endpoints'][0]['lb_endpoints'][0]['endpoint']['address']['socket_address']['port_value']=auth.port;base['static_resources']['clusters'].append(cluster)
 hcm(base)['http_filters'].insert(0,{'name':'envoy.filters.http.ext_authz','typed_config':{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.ext_authz.v3.ExtAuthz','http_service':{'server_uri':{'uri':'http://127.0.0.1:'+str(auth.port),'cluster':'authz','timeout':'0.2s'}},'failure_mode_allow':True,'status_on_error':{'code':'ServiceUnavailable'}}})
 original_route=routes(base)[0];hcm(base)['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes']=[{'match':{'path':'/health'},'direct_response':{'status':200,'body':{'inline_string':'ready'}},'typed_per_filter_config':{'envoy.filters.http.ext_authz':{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.ext_authz.v3.ExtAuthzPerRoute','disabled':True}}},original_route]
 before=copy.deepcopy(base)
 with Envoy(base) as old:assert old.request('/protected')[0]==200 and len(service.requests)==1,'native failure_mode_allow baseline did not bypass auth failure'
 fixed=student(task.configure,base);assert base==before and fixed['static_resources']['clusters']==base['static_resources']['clusters']
 with Envoy(fixed) as server:
  count=len(service.requests);assert server.request('/protected')[0]==503 and len(service.requests)==count,'auth server failure reached business upstream'
  auth_count=len(auth.requests);assert server.request('/health')[:2]==(200,b'ready') and len(auth.requests)==auth_count,'public health exemption regressed'
  auth.status=403;assert server.request('/protected')[0]==403 and len(service.requests)==count,'explicit authorization denial was changed or bypassed'
  auth.status=200;assert server.request('/protected')[0]==200 and len(service.requests)==count+1,'normal approved request lost access'
  auth.status=500;count=len(service.requests);assert server.request('/protected',headers={'x-envoy-auth-failure-mode-allowed':'true'})[0]==503 and len(service.requests)==count

print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

title: 真实JWT过滤器：RS256签名、issuer/audience、时效和唯一提取位置同时验收
answer:
```python
import copy,json
def configure(base,jwks):
    result=copy.deepcopy(base)
    hcm=result['static_resources']['listeners'][0]['filter_chains'][0]['filters'][0]['typed_config']
    hcm['http_filters'].insert(0,{'name':'envoy.filters.http.jwt_authn','typed_config':{
        '@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.jwt_authn.v3.JwtAuthentication',
        'providers':{'local':{'issuer':'https://issuer.opsforge.invalid','audiences':['opsforge-api'],
            'local_jwks':{'inline_string':json.dumps(jwks)},'forward':False,'from_headers':[{'name':'Authorization','value_prefix':'Bearer '}]}},
        'rules':[{'match':{'path':'/health'}},{'match':{'prefix':'/'},'requires':{'provider_name':'local'}}]}})
    return result
```

原题知识说明：
签名有效不等于令牌适用于当前服务，错误提取规则还可能接受非预期来源。按provider规则验证发行者、受众、时效及路径要求，测试错误受众和缺失令牌；不要只测试一个合法token。

## 操作任务
实现configure(base,jwks)，深拷贝后在router之前插入jwt_authn，使用批准内联JWKS、issuer=https://issuer.opsforge.invalid、audiences=[opsforge-api]；只从Authorization: Bearer提取，不能默认接受access_token查询参数。除原/health公开健康路由外全部路径都必须通过指定provider校验，禁止allow_missing降级；forward=False，成功验签后不把原Authorization令牌继续转发业务上游。保留原路由、cluster与公开健康策略，输入base/jwks不变。验收用实际RSA签名令牌，分别拒绝错误audience、issuer、过期、不同私钥签名、alg=none、缺令牌及仅查询参数令牌；有效原用户仍可访问。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Envoy1.36.13 jwt_authn和本地RSA2048/RS256签名；仅内联公钥，未验证远程JWKS缓存/轮换、OIDC发现或生产身份服务。测试私钥只在私有临时验收进程内生成，源码包不含凭据。

import os,sys,pathlib,copy,json,time,base64
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from envoy_native import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm,routes,student
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsa,padding
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes
def b64(value):return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(value).rstrip(b'=').decode()
key=rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537,key_size=2048);numbers=key.public_key().public_numbers()
def integer(value):return b64(value.to_bytes((value.bit_length()+7)//8,'big'))
jwks={'keys':[{'kty':'RSA','alg':'RS256','use':'sig','kid':'approved','n':integer(numbers.n),'e':integer(numbers.e)}]}
now=int(time.time());claims={'iss':'https://issuer.opsforge.invalid','aud':'opsforge-api','sub':'original-user','iat':now,'exp':now+600}
def token(changes=None,signer=key):
 payload={**claims,**(changes or {})};encoded=b64(json.dumps({'alg':'RS256','kid':'approved'},separators=(',',':')).encode())+'.'+b64(json.dumps(payload,separators=(',',':')).encode())
 return encoded+'.'+b64(signer.sign(encoded.encode(),padding.PKCS1v15(),hashes.SHA256()))
with Upstream() as upstream:
 base=bootstrap(upstream.port);hcm(base)['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes'].insert(0,{'match':{'path':'/health'},'direct_response':{'status':200,'body':{'inline_string':'ready'}}})
 before=copy.deepcopy(base);approved_keys=copy.deepcopy(jwks);fixed=student(task.configure,base,jwks)
 assert base==before and jwks==approved_keys and fixed['static_resources']['clusters']==base['static_resources']['clusters']
 with Envoy(fixed) as server:
  good=token();status,body,_=server.request('/protected',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+good});assert status==200
  assert not any(name.lower()=='authorization' for name in upstream.requests[-1]['headers']),'credential forwarded beyond verifier'
  count=len(upstream.requests)
  for bad in [token({'aud':'other-api'}),token({'iss':'https://different.invalid'}),token({'exp':now-3600}),token(signer=rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537,key_size=2048))]:
   assert server.request('/protected',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+bad})[0] in (401,403),'untrusted issuer, audience, lifetime or signature accepted'
  assert server.request('/protected')[0]==401,'missing token passed a protected route'
  assert server.request('/protected?access_token='+good)[0]==401,'query parameter silently became an approved token source'
  unsigned=b64(b'{"alg":"none"}')+'.'+b64(json.dumps(claims).encode())+'.'
  assert server.request('/protected',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+unsigned})[0]==401
  assert len(upstream.requests)==count,'rejected identity reached business upstream'
  assert server.request('/health')[:2]==(200,b'ready') and len(upstream.requests)==count

print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
